facts.fact: The institutional diagnosis of Bibey commune, made in September-October 2014 for its communal development plan, lists among the weaknesses of the commune's own assets the absence of an internet connection and of a website, beside no working electricity network or solar power and only partial telephone coverage; one commune, as stated by the plan's drafters.

facts.fact: With no internet connection at the commune of Bibey in September-October 2014, the plan records no online working: computerising payroll and financial management and equipping the administrative services with computers are listed as things still to be done.
